text:
emma: starting a short thread — proposing 'cohort-first fingerprint probe' rollout for Meridian routing (quantized variants + staged fallbacks). goal: minimize noisy-neighbor impact and have deterministic rollback per cohort

owen: short: love cohort-first. what's the smallest safe probe? suggest 0.1% global split into 100 fingerprint buckets => 0.001 each for 24h

li: telemetry gates we need: p95 latency delta, 5xx rate, user-visible error rate, dev-eval quality delta (A/B), and per-cohort regression count. also map each route to an SLA tag so fallback behavior depends on SLA

karim: automation plan: feature flag `meridian_cohort_v1` with cohort-buckets and per-bucket weight. rollout steps per-cohort: 1 bucket -> 5 buckets -> 25 -> 100 -> all. auto-degrade: if gate breach for 3 consecutive 5m windows, shrink affected cohorts to 0 and send page. implement shadowing for 1h before any cohort step

ops-bot: deploy lock: runbook required in PR. emergency flag name must be `meridian_kill_chain` and included

emma: propose explicit SLA routing rules: routes with SLA=high must prefer stable checkpoint -> Dedicated pool; SLA=low can accept synthesis-only fallback. we'll annotate routes with `sla:high|med|low` in routing config

owen: threshold proposal for initial probe:
```
- p95 latency increase <= 12ms
- 5xx spike <= +0.15% absolute
- quality regression <= -0.35% absolute
- cohort-visible-error-rate <= 0.5% of cohort traffic
- token-cost delta <= +7%
```

li: testing plan: generate synthetic traffic per-cohort+per-route, run side-by-side eval for 6h, sample 0.5% for human review for seeded enterprises

karim: fallback sequencing note: when a cohort fails, instead of full rollback we try per-request transient fallback: 1) quantized-fast 2) small-prompt summarizer 3) stable checkpoint. That keeps availability while limiting quality regressions. We'll add a metric 'fallback-churn' to monitor user impact

emma: customer ops: we'll seed with 12 enterprise tenants opt-in for 48h, include a per-tenant dashboard link and opt-out endpoint. small tenants get randomized bucket assignment. legal/data-residency flags respected per-region

owen: ops hooks: autoscale buffer +40% on Dedicated fallback pools during ramp, tracing tags for cohort id, and billing alerts if token-cost delta > +10% for 30m

li: quality: add edge-cases (long-code blocks, nested instructions) to eval suite, and add a regression alert to `research-oncall` at 0.2% regression on seeded tenants

emma: decision: proceed with cohort-first fingerprint probe. owners: emma (product), karim (infra), li (quality), owen (ops). I'll open flag PR with runbook and cohort bucket config. tentative deploy 2026-08-02T09:00Z

karim: I'll wire up shadowing, cohort tracing and auto-degrade hooks, will post PR link

ops-bot: deploy window locked until runbook url is present in PR. Use `/deploy unlock` after adding runbook.
